title: A "BLOODY DAY."
author: B. H. Roberts
note: Published 1900 by George Q. Cannon & Sons. Detailed history of the Missouri period persecutions of the Latter-day Saints.

footnotes.text: Philo Dibble lived to take part in the defense of the city of Nauvoo, some thirteen years later; afterwards removed with The Church to the Rocky Mountains, settling finally in Springville, Utah County, where he died in full faith of the gospel at the advanced age of 90, on the sixth of June 1895.
